title: Analysis of individual gait patterns to determine biomechanical risk factors in dentofacial anomalies – a prospective, monocentric study
summary: The aim of this study is to quantify the biomechanical characteristics of typical movement patterns in patients with dentofacial anomalies. The joint loads calculated using kinematics, kinetics, and specific parameters (primary and secondary endpoints) will be used to detect abnormal movement patterns.
